title: Thai GL Couples 101
description: Test your knowledge of pairings, shows, and milestones across all of Thai GL.

questions.question: Which pairing stars in Affair (2024)?
questions.explanation: Affair stars Sonya (Saranphat Pedersen) as Pleng and Lookmhee (Punyapat Wangpongsathaporn) as Wan — this pairing is known as LMSY. The show aired on ONE31 in 2024.

questions.question: Which show holds the title of Thailand's first GL period drama?
questions.explanation: The Loyal Pin (2024) made history as Thailand's first GL period drama, set in 1950s Thailand. It starred FreenBecky and aired on Workpoint TV.

questions.question: What was the first ever full-length Thai GL series?
questions.explanation: GAP The Series (2022) by Idol Factory made history as the first ever full-length Thai GL series. It stars FreenBecky (Freen Sarocha & Becky Armstrong) across 12 episodes.

questions.question: Which production company made 23.5?
questions.explanation: 23.5 is a GMMTV production starring Milk Pansa and Love Pattranite (the MilkLove pairing). It ran for 12 episodes and is available on Netflix (SEA & Latin America) and YouTube.

questions.question: In The Loyal Pin, what decade is the story set in?
questions.explanation: The Loyal Pin is set in 1950s Thailand, following Princess Anin and noble lady Pin — childhood friends navigating royal life, duty, and love in mid-century Siam.

questions.question: How many countries did The Loyal Pin trend in upon release?
questions.explanation: The Loyal Pin trended in 38 countries and ranked #1 in 20 of them — a remarkable global reach for a Thai GL series. It also surpassed 300 million views.

questions.question: Which pairing stars in Show Me Love — described as their first GL collaboration?
questions.explanation: Show Me Love on Grand TV Thailand was the first GL pairing for Engfa Waraha and Charlotte Austin — now known as EngLot. They went on to star in Petrichor, Unlimited Love, 4 Elements: The Water, and Love Bully.

title: The Loyal Pin Deep Dive
description: For the dedicated FreenBecky fans. How deeply do you know Anin & Pin's story?

questions.question: What is Pin's full name in The Loyal Pin?
questions.explanation: Pin's full name is Pilantita. She is a noble lady and childhood friend of Princess Anin, played by Becky Armstrong.

questions.question: What is Anin's full name in The Loyal Pin?
questions.explanation: Princess Anilaphat, played by Freen Sarocha, is the royal lead of the series — a princess navigating duty and her feelings for her childhood companion Pin.

questions.question: Where does Anin go to study, separating her from Pin?
questions.explanation: Princess Anin is sent to study in England, which creates the central distance between her and Pin. The separation shapes the emotional tension throughout the series.

questions.question: How many episodes does The Loyal Pin have?
questions.explanation: The Loyal Pin ran for 16 episodes, airing from August to November 2024 on Workpoint TV and YouTube.

questions.question: Which channel did The Loyal Pin originally air on in Thailand?
questions.explanation: The Loyal Pin aired on Workpoint TV in Thailand alongside a YouTube release — a combination that helped it reach its massive global audience.

questions.question: What makes The Loyal Pin unique in Thai GL history?
questions.explanation: The Loyal Pin is Thailand's first GL period drama — set in 1950s Thailand, it broke new ground for the genre both in storytelling scope and historical setting.

title: The GAP Universe
description: GAP, Affair, and the connected world of Idol Factory's GL output. Do you know it all?

questions.question: What is the name of the novel author who wrote the source material for both GAP and Affair?
questions.explanation: Author Chao Planoy wrote the novels that became both GAP The Series and Affair. Affair is explicitly stated to be part of the GAP universe.

questions.question: In Affair, how many years pass between Pleng and Wan's childhood separation and their reunion?
questions.explanation: Pleng and Wan are separated by tragedy and reunite 13 years later as adults. Pleng is from a wealthy family; Wan's mother was Pleng's family's maid.

questions.question: The Affair OST is 'I'm Yours' — who recorded it?
questions.explanation: 'I'm Yours' is performed by Sonya (Saranphat Pedersen) and Lookmhee (Punyapat Wangpongsathaporn), the LMSY pairing who star in the show itself.

questions.question: In Affair, what is Wan's profession when she and Pleng reunite?
questions.explanation: When Pleng and Wan reunite after 13 years, Wan has become a doctor — a significant leap from her humble origins as the daughter of Pleng's family's maid.

questions.question: How many episodes does Affair have?
questions.explanation: Affair ran for 8 episodes, airing August–October 2024 on ONE31. Despite its short run, it became one of the most-discussed Thai GL releases of 2024.

questions.question: Which pairing stars in Affair?
questions.explanation: Affair stars Lookmhee (Punyapat Wangpongsathaporn) as Wan and Sonya (Saranphat Pedersen) as Pleng — the LMSY pairing. Hometown Romance (2026) is their third GL collaboration.

title: The Secret of Us
description: LingOrm's Netflix Thai GL — how well do you know Lingling and Orm's story?

questions.question: Which pairing stars in The Secret of Us?
questions.explanation: LingOrm — Lingling Sirilak Kwong and Orm Kornnaphat Sethratanapong — star as the two leads. The Secret of Us was their breakout GL together and launched them into the international Thai GL spotlight.

questions.question: On which streaming platform did The Secret of Us premiere?
questions.explanation: The Secret of Us is a Netflix Original Thai series — one of the first Thai GL productions to debut directly on a major global streaming platform, giving it instant worldwide reach.

questions.question: What year did The Secret of Us premiere?
questions.explanation: The Secret of Us premiered on Netflix in 2024 — the same year that The Loyal Pin trended in 38 countries, making 2024 arguably Thai GL's biggest international year.

questions.question: What is Ling's full real name?
questions.explanation: Ling's full name is Lingling Sirilak Kwong. She is half Thai, half Hong Kong Chinese — her first name Lingling reflects her Chinese heritage, while Sirilak is her Thai name and Kwong her Chinese surname.

questions.question: What is Orm's full real name?
questions.explanation: Orm's full name is Kornnaphat Sethratanapong. Together with Lingling Sirilak Kwong, she forms the LingOrm pairing — one of Thai GL's most beloved duos of 2024.

questions.question: Which GMMTV Thai GL series had Netflix distribution before The Secret of Us?
questions.explanation: 23.5 (GMMTV, 2024) starring MilkLove (Milk Pansa & Love Pattranite) had Netflix distribution in Southeast Asia and Latin America, helping build the platform's appetite for Thai GL content.

questions.question: Which major 2024 Thai GL show did NOT air on Netflix?
questions.explanation: The Loyal Pin (FreenBecky) aired on Workpoint TV and YouTube — not Netflix. Yet it still became one of the most-viewed Thai GL series ever, trending in 38 countries without a Netflix deal.

questions.question: What does Ling's nickname 'Ling' (ลิง) mean in Thai?
questions.explanation: 'Ling' (ลิง) means monkey in Thai — a playful contrast to her graceful on-screen presence. Her co-star's name 'Orm' (อ้อม) means 'to embrace', giving the LingOrm ship name an unintentionally sweet double meaning.
